title: JadenMan's God Trident
description: This plugin adds the god trident from JadenMan's video slightly modified.
body:
**A powerful custom trident with:**

- Automatic Riptide III
- Automatic Storms
- Lightning Strike on Hit
- Shield Piercing
- Sharpness V Sword Damage
- Custom Model Data: 321
- Custom Crafting Recipe
- Unbreakable
- Lore

_Blessed by the sea god, feared by all who stand below._

## Recipe:
![recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0a41d12123ee0dae9fa89d3eff1f3030789b2949.png)

## Command:

```/poseidontrident```

**Permission:** OP only

```
recipe:
  A: DIAMOND_SPEAR
  B: DIAMOND_SPEAR
  C: DIAMOND_SPEAR

  D: WITHER_SKELETON_SKULL
  E: TRIDENT
  F: WITHER_SKELETON_SKULL

  G: WITHER_SKELETON_SKULL
  H: HEART_OF_THE_SEA
  I: WITHER_SKELETON_SKULL
```
